messages:
nina: morning! showing off my new standing setup. swivel monitor + yoga ball for core strength. pic: <https://files.redwood.ai/nina-stand.jpg|nina-stand.jpg> 
jorge: no way, the yoga ball is a hazard but also awesome. do you have a rubber mat? 
mika: balance PR from 0 to 60 in 2 days. please post a video of you trying to reach a snack without wobbling. 
ops-bot: Reminder: office chairs are available in the equipment closet. Submit requests at /equipment if you want a chair swap. 
sam: pro tip: if you use a yoga ball, inflate it slightly less than full for stability. also keep a wall nearby. 
nina: good call. i did the half-inflate thing. survived a 2h meeting without rolling away.  
jorge: lol, imagine an accidental bounce into a call. would be great meme material. 
mika: also quick question: has anyone replaced their home ethernet patch before? thinking of running a short run to move the router upstairs. 
sam: yes. use cat6a for future-proofing. keep run length <30m for neatness, and label both ends. 
nina: thanks! i'll try that this weekend unless the ball wins and i become permanently anchored to it. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
ops-bot: Kudos: nina for creative WFH ergonomics (reaction: :tada:).
